cases.name: Suela Saliaj
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was born in Albania and worked as Client Service Associate Senior at PNC Bank. She is survived by her daughter Alessia, her brother Enea, her parents Vera and Muke and many nieces, nephews, cousins, and friends.

Suela was our life, our joy, a daughter, a sister, a cousin, a best friend, the best mommy to Alessia. Everyone will remember her as the most loving soul, the most dedicated mom, the best coworker. Everyone who had the chance to know her, is lucky. She loved the nature, travelling, being happy, and always being surrounded by the people she loved most. We will always remember her dancing with Alessia, getting crazy together, and always being free to enjoy life.

Sunsets held a special place in her heart; she embodied the essence of a sunset enthusiast, earning her the title of the "sunset girl."
cases.narrative:
On 1/29/2024, police found her dead on the floor of her bedroom covered in blood with a laceration to her throat. Her daughter told police told police that she saw Muhaj strike Saliaj several times with the knife and brass knuckles in her bedroom. The girl went on to tell police that she knew the woman was dead and asked Muhaj, "Why would you do that?" The girl said Muhaj’s reply was that he "really wanted her to die."

The affidavit states that after killing Saliaj, Muhaj took the girl from the home, rushing her down the stairs and causing her to fall. The child said Muhaj dragged her onto the concrete to get her into the car. She suffered bruises and abrasions during the incident.

Police investigating an assault he allegedly perpetrated against his parents had contacted Largo authorities and asked them to do a welfare check on his ex-girlfriend and 8-year-old daughter.
